blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When your computer has a problem, you call the help desk. In "Calling IT Support", you learn the simple English you need to ask for help.

You can ask questions in a polite way. You say "Can you help me?" or "Can you fix this?". The team is small, but it is very fast. They open a ticket for your problem and they fix it.

Good IT habits are important. Small habits today save big problems tomorrow. Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: What does the IT team do when you have a problem?
options: They open a ticket and fix it
items.why: "They open a ticket for your problem and they fix it."

items.q: How can you ask for help in a polite way?
items.why: O texto ensina "Can you help me?" como pedido educado.

items.q: What does the text say about the IT team?
options: It is small but very fast
items.why: "The team is small, but it is very fast."

items.q: The text suggests that good IT habits are…
items.why: Inferência: "Small habits today save big problems tomorrow" — ajudam no futuro.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "Asking IT for help is a bad idea."
"You can ask for help in a polite way."
"Calling IT support is easy to learn."
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo incentiva pedir ajuda ao suporte, então discordaria da ideia de que é ruim.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James, do suporte de TI, atender a ligação. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, this is James from IT support. How can I help you today?

Okay, your email is not working. That is a common issue. Don't worry, I can help you. First, let me open a ticket for you. The ticket number is one-four-seven.

Is this urgent? Do you have a meeting soon? Okay, good. It is not urgent, so we have some time.

Now, please try one simple thing. Can you close your email and open it again? Sometimes that is the fix. Wait ten seconds, then open it.

Is it working now? Great! I am happy to hear that. If the same issue comes back, just call IT support again. We are here every day. Have a good afternoon!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking on the phone?
items.why: "Hello, this is James from IT support."

items.q: What is the problem?
items.why: "your email is not working."

items.q: What does James ask the person to do?
options: Close the email and open it again
items.why: "Can you close your email and open it again?"

items.q: The call suggests that the problem is…
items.why: Inferência: James chama de "common issue", diz "not urgent" e resolve com um passo simples.

items.q: How would you describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Don't worry", "I can help you" e "Have a good afternoon" — calmo e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our IT support is very fast." Support means…
items.why: Support = suporte, ajuda.

items.q: "There is a new issue with my email." An issue is a…
items.why: Issue = problema.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "IT opened a ___ for my problem. The number is 147."
items.why: Ticket = chamado, aberto pelo suporte.

items.q: "This is urgent. I have a meeting in five minutes!" Urgent means…
items.why: Urgent = urgente, precisa ser rápido.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can you ___ my computer, please? It is not working."
items.why: Fix = consertar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando você liga para o suporte. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you help me? My email is down." When email is down, it is…
items.why: Be down = estar fora do ar, não funcionar.

items.q: "Please turn off your computer and wait." To turn off means to…
items.why: Turn off = desligar.

items.q: "Let me look into this problem." To look into means to…
items.why: Look into = examinar, verificar.

items.q: "I will call you back in five minutes." To call back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de novo depois.

items.q: "The problem is sorted out now." This means the problem is…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, deixar em ordem.
